title: JACKETEK Material / Construction Matrix v0.1 (K2)
rule: No specification value invented. Body = Cotton Fabric and sleeves = Leather are design intent; every composition, weight, thickness, finish, dimension and stitch value is TBD_SUPPLIER_PROPOSAL or TBD_PATTERN_MAKER. S.i. template text is REFERENCE ONLY. Embroidery placement (zones) is not part of this matrix.

k2.v01Text: Kept verbatim in v0.1 `conflicts` ("The configurator offers leather or Cotton Fabric for body and sleeves…").
resolved: Varsity rib components required: collar, cuffs, waistband (knitted rib, striped colourway supported, matching system)
unresolved: Hardware dimensions, alloy, plating, supplier codes
Sewing construction (seams, allowances, SPI, topstitching, reinforcement)
Pocket build details not shown by the drawing (opening edge, bag, bartacks, inside pocket)
k2.notApproved: Nothing in K2 is approved for production. Every specification comes from a supplier proposal and/or the pattern maker and is approved by JACKETEK only after the physical M sample.
k2.sampleScope: The factory proposal covers Cotton Fabric body + Leather sleeves only (see X-01).

leatherPolicy.alternatives: ALTERNATIVE SUPPLIER PROPOSAL — NOT CURRENT JACKETEK DESIGN INTENT
leatherPolicy.rule: A supplier may propose synthetic / PU (or other) alternatives only as clearly labelled alternative proposals. They never silently replace Leather. For each alternative record the cost, MOQ, performance and appearance differences against the leather proposal. Changing the design intent needs explicit JACKETEK approval.

contradictions.topic: Customer material choice vs design intent
contradictions.detail: The configurator lets the customer choose Leather or Cotton Fabric for the body and for the sleeves separately; v0.1 BOM01 / BOM02 and dataOwnership record a customer choice. JACKETEK design intent is body = Cotton Fabric, sleeves = Leather — the configurator's default and RFQ-05's values.
contradictions.action: Recorded, website not changed. Product decision open: whether other combinations stay orderable. The factory proposal covers only Cotton Fabric body + Leather sleeves.

contradictions.detail: Shown as "Cotton Fabric", stored as id "felt"; code comments say "wool felt" and the story copy keys say "wool". Golden Bear's reference body is melton wool; the S.i. template example is 100% Wool.
contradictions.action: "Cotton Fabric" (the customer-facing name) is the design intent. No wool or felt composition is implied. Internal id not changed.

contradictions.detail: Website copy promises "supple leather that softens with wear" and "a soft, natural sheen" — qualities of genuine leather. K2.2 leaves genuine vs synthetic open for the supplier.
contradictions.action: Leather stays the design intent; synthetic / PU is an alternative proposal only. If JACKETEK ever approves an alternative, the website copy must be reviewed first. Copy not changed now.

contradictions.detail: Legacy sheet and the 3D model cut the welts from the sleeve material; RFQ and legacy drawings colour the welts as the sleeves; v0.1 BOM13 says "leather or shell fabric" and the RFQ lists it TBD_SUPPLIER_PROPOSAL. The S.i. template calls them "contrasting" (template text).
contradictions.action: OPEN. Welt material: FACTORY TO PROPOSE / JACKETEK TO APPROVE. Leather matching the sleeves (as drawn) is a visual reference / option only, not a decision. Build TBD_PATTERN_MAKER.

contradictions.detail: Legacy sheet: 7 snaps (5 placket + 2 on the waistband tab) and 2 "front tabs". S.i. flat: 6 snap marks (5 placket + 1 on the waistband) and a waistband-tab layer. RFQ: count TBD_PATTERN_MAKER (F03–F07).
contradictions.action: Count, spacing and the tab stay TBD_PATTERN_MAKER. Neither drawing is a specification.

contradictions.detail: v0.1 BOM09: "the configurator has no stripe option today"; the 3D preview, RFQ and legacy sheet show stripes in the sleeve colour (SYSTEM_DERIVED); the website shows a "striped rib cuff". The legacy rib heights come from 5 strips of the 3D mesh, not a stripe specification.
contradictions.action: Striped colourway supported as construction intent; stripe count, widths, positions and yarn stay open.

contradictions.detail: Golden Bear uses quilted satin acetate; the S.i. template shows "internal quilting" (template demo); v0.1 BOM05 says quilting is undecided; the 3D model has only a dark inside render material.
contradictions.action: No project evidence decides quilted vs plain: TBD_SUPPLIER_PROPOSAL with JACKETEK decision after the sample.

contradictions.detail: The configurator previews satin stitch only; the website shows raised chenille, "Cotton patch" letter styles and "Class patches"; the RFQ asks the supplier to propose the technique.
contradictions.action: Method per artwork type TBD_SUPPLIER_PROPOSAL. The website's chenille / patch imagery is product direction, not a specification.

contradictions.detail: v0.1 L04 says whether an inside pocket is fitted is undecided; the S.i. template shows an internal welt pocket (template demo).
contradictions.action: UNKNOWN — JACKETEK decision; if fitted, build TBD_PATTERN_MAKER.

contradictions.detail: ZIPPER_ENABLED = false and the RFQ prints "Not fitted", but the configurator's closure help text still mentions "an optional hidden zipper".
contradictions.action: NOT_FITTED for K2. Website text not changed.

contradictions.detail: Golden Bear has a leather cuff protector; v0.1 BOM22 marks it UNKNOWN for JACKETEK. Not shown on the S.i. flat or the 3D model.
contradictions.action: UNKNOWN — not fitted unless JACKETEK decides otherwise.

contradictions.detail: Golden Bear (melton wool / leather, quilted lining, set-in) and the S.i. template example (100% wool, 2×1 cotton rib 350 GSM, cotton thread) describe other garments. The S.i. callouts appear in the Blank file too: template demo content.
Website copy claims clean-finished seams; every v0.1 construction operation is TO_SET_BY_PATTERN_MAKER with no value.
contradictions.action: Seam finish TBD_PATTERN_MAKER; the claim must be met by the approved construction or the copy reviewed.
